tags.name: Research Powerhouse
tags.blurb: The papers come out faster than the undergraduates.
tags.why: The research is strong, and stronger than the teaching.

teeth.line: Grants and gifts follow the papers: a tenth more giving each year.

tags.name: Teaching College
tags.blurb: Small classes, and professors who know your name.
tags.why: The teaching is strong, and stronger than the research.

teeth.line: Students who are known by name stay: one point less attrition a year.

tags.name: Party School
tags.why: The students are happy, and the classes they arrive in are not the most demanding.

teeth.line: The college pays for the parties: $400 a student a year more on discipline and student life.

tags.name: Jock School
tags.blurb: The stadium is the biggest building on campus, and everyone knows the fight song.
tags.why: The teams and their venues are what the college is known for.

teeth.line: Recruits want to play here: every team six points stronger.

tags.name: Artsy
tags.blurb: Studios open all night and a gallery in every stairwell.
tags.why: The arts: their programmes, their buildings, their share of the campus.

teeth.line: Studios and galleries everywhere: five points of campus beauty.

tags.name: Commuter
tags.blurb: Most of the students go home at five.
tags.why: Too few beds for the students: most of them go home at night.

teeth.line: Nobody stays after five: two points off every class's satisfaction.

tags.name: Country Club
tags.blurb: Beautiful grounds, a long waiting list, and a lot of sailing.
tags.why: A dear sticker, little aid, and a beautiful campus.

teeth.line: Old boys write cheques: fifteen per cent more giving each year.

tags.name: Pressure Cooker
tags.blurb: The library never closes, and nobody leaves it.
tags.why: Very selective, and the students are not happy about it.

teeth.line: Not everyone lasts: one and a half points more attrition a year.

tags.name: The Bargain
tags.blurb: A good degree at a price a family can say out loud.
tags.why: A net price well under the market's, for a respectable class.

teeth.line: Families say yes: four points more of the admitted accept.

tags.name: Old Money
tags.blurb: Endowed before anyone alive was born, and dressed for it.
tags.why: A large endowment, held a long time.

teeth.line: A name that opens doors: three points more of the admitted accept.

words.title: What the guidebooks say
words.none: Nothing yet. The guidebooks wait to see what the college does for a few years before they decide what it is.
words.hint: Identity is earned and shed from how the college is run, two years at a time. It shapes who applies: how many, and how good.
